reply.emotion: pleased and relieved on payday, feeling valued for the work done
notes: Use sueldo for the regular money you receive each month from your job. Compare with salario, which is very similar, though sueldo often implies a steady monthly payment for office or professional work.

senses.definition: Cantidad de dinero que se paga regularmente a un trabajador por su trabajo.

examples.text: Con mi nuevo sueldo puedo pagar el alquiler y ahorrar un poco cada mes.
examples.translation: With my new salary I can pay the rent and save a little each month.
examples.emotion: optimistic and proud, looking forward to financial stability

definitions: Cantidad de dinero que se paga regularmente a un trabajador por su trabajo.
